title: AI Fundamentals and Workplace Applications
objective: Understand AI capabilities, limitations, and appropriate workplace applications.
activity: Complete an introductory AI literacy module and evaluate common workplace AI use cases.

title: Practical Prompt Design
objective: Develop effective instructions and refine AI interactions to produce useful outputs.
activity: Practice writing, testing, and improving prompts using approved workplace scenarios.

title: Integrating AI into Everyday Workflows
objective: Identify appropriate AI-supported tasks and evaluate workflow effectiveness.
activity: Map an existing work process and identify opportunities for responsible AI integration.

title: Evaluating and Verifying AI Outputs
objective: Evaluate AI-generated content for accuracy, completeness, and reliability.
activity: Review sample AI-generated reports, identify unsupported claims, and practice source verification.

title: Responsible AI: Privacy, Bias, and Data Handling
objective: Recognize privacy, security, fairness, and policy considerations in workplace AI use.
activity: Complete case studies involving confidential information, potential bias, and approved AI use.

title: Human Oversight in AI-Supported Decisions
objective: Identify situations requiring human review, escalation, and decision accountability.
activity: Evaluate simulated workplace decisions and establish appropriate human review checkpoints.

title: Effective Human-AI Collaboration
objective: Coordinate human judgment and AI assistance to produce reliable workplace deliverables.
activity: Complete a collaborative task involving AI-supported drafting, human verification, and final review.

title: Adapting to AI-Enabled Workplace Change
objective: Develop strategies for adapting to new AI tools and contributing to continuous improvement.
activity: Create a personal AI learning plan and identify opportunities to improve an existing workflow.
